facts.fact: The World Bank's GovTech Maturity Index regional brief says the Data Exchange Platform (PDEX), a service bus launched with the NOSI Cloud in 2018, is extensively used by both central and local governments; it gives no count of local governments and does not say how their offices are connected (2022 index data).

systems.tiers: national; no local government office said to be on it
launched 2017 to provide public services in municipal councils; who runs it and what it does are not stated
